title: The heat before the Fourth
logline: The dock in the last week of June at noon: the planks bleached, the tar soft, the pup flat under the ramp, Gully's daughter, twelve, with a hose, spraying the planks. Nobody's face. Heat as a subject.

panels.composition: A dock at noon with bleached planks and soft tar, a small three-legged dog flat in the shade under a ramp, a twelve-year-old girl from behind spraying the planks with a hose.
